mechanism: Recognize the physical command-substitution delimiter with alias expansion suppressed, then parse the bounded source with normal alias semantics. Classify the complete unquoted digit run only before a less-than or greater-than redirection operator as one IO number, parse multi-digit descriptor duplication names within mksh's checked descriptor range, reserve descriptors 0 through 31 for users while moving shell-private descriptors to 32 and above, and require an unquoted POSIX NAME for the name() function-definition form.
standards_authority: IEEE Std 1003.1-2017, Shell Command Language 2.2.3, 2.6.3, and 2.10.1
